body:
Scope addendum 7 (maintainer, chat 2026-09-19, verbatim: 「但是功能清单我还需要一个可以人工阅读确认的入口」):

7. A human-readable entry point, GENERATED never hand-written: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/STATUS.md`, produced by the status command of item 5 (`gen:checklist-status`), one section per definition item / area, each listing its `active` and `planned` items with id, title and priority. Paired with `check:checklist-status`, which reds in CI when the page differs from the generator output (the same gen/check mechanism as `gen:spec-changes` / `check:spec-changes`). Edits go to the area JSON (the source); the page follows. The page carries numbers because they come from the command; the North Star page still carries none.

Acceptance addendum: `pnpm gen:checklist-status` on the current tree writes the page (15 sections, 264 active, 0 planned); `check:checklist-status` green on it and RED after a one-character edit to the page; the page is linked from `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md` as the reading entry.

Amendment to addendum 7 (maintainer, chat 2026-09-19, verbatim: 「不需要 配套 CI 检查 check:checklist-status」): NO `check:checklist-status` and no CI pairing. `STATUS.md` is regenerated by `gen:checklist-status` and committed by whoever changes the area JSON (the skill text for `checklist-author` says so in one line); staleness is tolerated, not gated. The acceptance addendum shrinks to: `pnpm gen:checklist-status` writes the page (15 sections, 264 active, 0 planned) and README links it.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Amendment 2 to addendum 7 (maintainer, chat 2026-09-19, verbatim: 「既然是生成的，定期生成不就好了？」): the entry point is produced on a SCHEDULE, not committed to the repo. A workflow (`schedule:` weekly + `workflow_dispatch`) runs `pnpm gen:checklist-status` and publishes the page to the repository wiki (one stable URL; the wiki is outside branch protection and the merge queue) and mirrors it into the job summary. No `STATUS.md` in the tree, no `check:checklist-status`, no regen-on-edit rule. The workflow file lives under `.github/workflows/**` ⇒ human merge only (the seat token lacks the workflow scope); the dev opens it as a separate draft PR beside the ledger PR.

Acceptance for item 7 becomes: `workflow_dispatch` run green, wiki page present with 15 sections and the counts the command prints, README links the wiki page.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Amendment 3 to addendum 7 (maintainer, chat 2026-09-19: 「写入仓库 wiki，是否建议分模块写？」 → seat: split per area; agreed): the generator writes ONE index page `Platform-Checklist` (one row per area = definition item: area, active count, planned count, link) and ONE page per area `Checklist-<area>` (every item: id · title · priority · status · personas; the `planned` items in their own section first). One area JSON → one wiki page; the index is the 「功能清单 + 实现状态」 overview. Acceptance for item 7: 16 wiki pages after a `workflow_dispatch` run (index + 15 areas), index counts equal the command output.

Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`
Clause-②: **yes** (widening)

## ⛔ Why a `domain:spec` seat is holding a `domain:skills` card

The maintainer said 「19157 插队」 in this session. 优先序 puts 维护者裁决 above every lane convention, so the card is taken now rather than handed across and queued behind a handoff.

⛔ This is **not** a re-route and ⛔ not a re-grade: `domain:skills` stays on the card, `priority:p1` stays, no `type` is written. `domain:skills#*` — if you were about to take this, say so on this thread and I will release it in the same minute. The filing seat amended this card four times in three minutes and may have been minutes from claiming it; that is the collision I am most worried about and the reason this paragraph exists.

## ⚠️ The scope is NOT the title, and it moved four times in three minutes

Pinned as of comment `5738032962`. A dev dispatched against the body alone would build the wrong thing:

| # | as the body says | as the amendments leave it |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 7 (addendum) | a generated `STATUS.md` in the tree, paired with `check:checklist-status` | ⛔ **no `STATUS.md` in the tree**, ⛔ **no `check:checklist-status`, no CI pairing** |
| 7 (amendment 2) | — | produced on a **schedule** (`schedule:` weekly + `workflow_dispatch`) and published to the **repository wiki**; the workflow file is a **separate draft PR**, human-merged, because the seat token lacks the `workflow` scope |
| 7 (amendment 3) | one page | **16 wiki pages**: one index `Platform-Checklist` (a row per area: area, active count, planned count, link) + one `Checklist-<area>` per area, `planned` items in their own section first |

⇒ **two PRs, not one**, and they land by different routes.

## ⛔ Path surface, read before any work — this is a GOVERNED, Tier S change

**PR A (the ledger PR)** touches `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/checklist-author/SKILL.md`. `.claude/**` is on the governed register, and under the tiering ruling (#19144, `governedTierFor`) `.claude/**` is **Tier S**: it lands on a **contract-tier review of record** on the PR thread — `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` plus `**VERDICT: PASS**` — and then the merge queue. ⛔ Not a human merge, ⛔ and never the queue without that record: a Tier S merge lacking one is a finding against this seat in the post-merge governed audit.

⚠️ **Tier is ALL, not ANY.** If any hunk of PR A lands on a Tier H path (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/**`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, published `skills/**`), the whole PR becomes Tier H and waits for the maintainer. Scope item 6 already anticipates this: the North Star's 「账本」 sentence stays untouched, and AGENTS.md is touched only if a pointer there must name the status axis — **if the dev finds it must, that is a STOP and a report, not a decision.** `docs/qa/**` and `scripts/**` are not governed.

**PR B (the workflow PR)** is `.github/workflows/**` alone — ⛔ **not** on the governed register, but human-merged for a different reason the maintainer gave: the seat token lacks the `workflow` scope. It is opened as a separate draft.

## Why `Clause-②: yes`

By the maintainer's own contract-surface test — 「拿一份作者写的元数据,改动前后喂进去,接受还是拒绝的结果变了吗?」 — an area JSON carrying `status: planned` is **refused today** by `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` and **accepted after**. The result changes, and it changes in the **widening** direction, which is条款② by the lane's own line (「放宽接受集或扩大公开面的卡,不论多小,即条款②」). ⛔ The dev does not re-declare this; if the work turns out to move no accept set at all, it reports that and I correct the claim.

## The 仪器 question, already answered on the card and not re-derived here

北极星「仪器为车队服务」: the fleet decision that differs is **the disposition of every capability-gap card in the live two-repo sweep** — kept with a `Path:` pointing at a planned item, versus closed as 「不在清单上」 — and where `checklist-author` writes a gap it finds. That is 「一次本来会派错的派发」 in the North Star's own list of four. ⇒ the card's p1 stands on its own reasoning; ⛔ I am not re-grading it.

## Acceptance the dev must hit, from the card and its amendments

- Fixture area file with one `planned` item: `check-platform-checklist.mjs` **green** when the kind is still mapped by an active item, **RED (unmapped)** when the kind's only item is planned; the self-test pins **both** directions.
- RUNNER selector on that area reports the item as `planned` and runs nothing for it — ⛔ never pass/fail/blocked.
- Status command on the current tree prints **264 active · 0 planned across 15 areas** — ⛔ numbers from the command, never typed into a page.
- `workflow_dispatch` run green; **16 wiki pages** (index + 15 areas); index counts equal the command output; README links the wiki page.
- Green: `check:doc-authoring`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (both skills' ceilings), `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`.

## Related, and the ordering the card states

**#19155** (`Path:` line carries 定义项 | 清单项 id 或缺项) reads this card's planned ids as the 「缺项」 half. It lands **after** this one, or names `缺项` as a placeholder. ⛔ Not this dev's to touch.

---

## ⛔ Seat correction — this claim named ONE branch while the card mandates TWO

The half-state patrol raised **H46** on PR #19162: its body carries `Fixes #19157`, while no `Claim:` on this thread named its branch `claude/issue-19157-checklist-status-workflow`. ⇒ merging it would have attributed the card to a branch the card never recorded as claimed, and **nothing on the board would have stopped a second seat taking that half.**

⛔ My error, and it was visible in my own text: the same claim that says 「**two PRs, not one**, and they land by different routes」 then names a single branch on its `Branch:` line. The line above now names both; ⛔ nothing else in this claim is changed.

⚠️ Also fixed in the same pass, from the same sweep: **H31** — `needs:contract-review` was hung on this card and on PR #19161 but **not** on PR #19162, which is also a delivering PR of this card. The gate is a **DUAL carrier** (「两边都挂好」), so a half-written pair is indistinguishable from a strip. It is now on all three carriers.

⭐ The remedy this patrol offered for H46 had two arms — name the branch in a claim, or weaken PR B's body to `Part of #19157`. I took the first: PR B is the one that lands LAST (it needs `pnpm gen:checklist-status`, which PR A adds), so the closing keyword belongs on it and the claim is what was incomplete.
